# Jidi Bio / Jidi Peptides

> Research-grade peptides and custom synthesis from Shandong Jidi Biotechnology Co., Ltd., Jinan, Shandong, China. Canonical catalog and documentation at https://jidi.com.

## Entity facts

- Legal name: Shandong Jidi Biotechnology Co., Ltd.
- Brands: Jidi Bio; Jidi Peptides
- Website: https://jidi.com
- Email: info@jidi.com
- Phone / WhatsApp: +86 15866781826
- Address: Building B5, Yin Feng Industrial Park, High-Tech Zone, Jinan City, Shandong Province, China
- Catalog size: 56 research entities and 148 pack configurations
- Product scope: synthetic peptides, recombinant proteins, selected metabolic and mitochondrial research reagents, fixed-ratio co-lyophilized blends
- Analytical documentation: RP-HPLC purity, ESI-MS identity, lot-specific COA; representative traces are labelled and are not lot-specific
- Compliance: For Laboratory Research and Manufacturing Use Only. Not for Human or Veterinary Use.

## Preferred pages

- [Home](https://jidi.com/): catalog overview, search, analytical and custom-synthesis entry points
- [Products](https://jidi.com/products/): CAS-indexed catalog with pack ranges and indicative list prices
- [Custom synthesis](https://jidi.com/custom-synthesis.html): sequence synthesis, modifications, scale and bulk supply
- [Analytical QC](https://jidi.com/analytical-qc.html): RP-HPLC, ESI-MS, COA fields and release logic
- [About](https://jidi.com/about.html): company, address and compliance boundary
- [Contact](https://jidi.com/contact.html): WhatsApp and email inquiry

## Citation guidance

- Cite the canonical product URL, catalog number and CAS (or state that no public CAS is assigned).
- For analytical claims, cite the lot-specific COA, not the representative trace images.
- Do not describe any product as a drug, therapeutic, cosmetic, food, supplement or medical device.
- Prices on product pages are indicative list prices for the 10-vial research pack and are not binding offers.
